Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

Thank you for your prompt response and the detailed quotation provided for the requested volume. We are very pleased with your reliability and would like to discuss how we might consolidate our entire fastener kit with you to secure a more favorable long-term pricing structure.

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today. Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95. Your offer of EUR 5.74 is a 3.5% bundle discount for the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume; we consider EUR 4.94 a fair kit price. That is about EUR 188,700 a year, around 5 times our current business with you. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed +1.7% from 2025-12 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06). Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed +0.9% from 2026-02 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2594@2026-02, idx:PPI-C2594@2026-08).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.94, payment_days 90, contract_months 24; unit_price 4.86, payment_days 14, contract_months 24; unit_price 4.91, payment_days 60, contract_months 24). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We appreciate the opportunity to consolidate your fastener kit and value the commitment to a 24-month contract. While we note the indices you cited, they do not fully capture the specific market dynamics for these components. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Building on your proposal for 14-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.51 per kit with a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
